Images shall print correctly on Seamonkey.
Lists shall print correctly on Seamonkey.
Tables shal print correctly on Seamonkey.
Character styles shall print correctly on Seamonkey.

reference_cases.title: TC-109
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Launch Apprunner
2. Click here to view a page with horizontal frames
3. Click here to view a page with vertical frames.
4. Once each page loads, select menu option "FILE| PRINT"
5. Press "OK" on Print Dialog Box to print the page.

EXPECTED RESULTS
After Step 5, the page should be printed as seen on screen

reference_cases.title: TC-113
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Launch Apprunner
2. Click here to view a sample page
3. Select menu option "FILE| PRINT"
4. Click on the "Properties" button.
5. Under the "Page Setup" option, in the frame titled "Orientation", select the radio button titled "Portrait"
6. Press OK twice to print the page
7. Repeat step 1 thru 3 and select the radio button titled "Landscape" under the "Orientation" Frame.
8. Press "OK" twice to print the page

EXPECTED RESULTS
After Step 6, the page should be printed in Portrait setting
After Step 8, the page should be printed in Landscape setting

reference_cases.title: TC-116
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION

EXPECTED RESULTS
All CSS pages should print as they appear on screen

reference_cases.title: TC-119
reference_cases.description:

reference_cases.title: TC-127
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Browse test page
2. Select "FILE | PRINT" Preview menu option
3. Click on Next Page and make sure it goes to next page
4. Click on Zoom In to zoom into page
5. Click on Zoom Out to zoom out of page
6. Click on Previous Page and make sure it goes back
7. Click on Close and make sure it closes preview window

EXPECTED RESULTS

reference_cases.title: TC-129
reference_cases.description:
INITIAL CONDITIONS
You should have a local printer connected to your machine to test this

STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Launch the browser
2. Go to Windows Build Prerequisites
3. Select "File | Work Offline"
4. Select "File | Print"

EXPECTED RESULTS
All pages should get printed even when you are offline

reference_cases.title: TC-130
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Launch the browser
2. Go to Windows Build Prerequisites
3. Select "File| Print"
4. The printed pages should have the webpage name and the url on top left/right
5. The bottom of the printed pages should show the number of pages printed and date/time (system)

EXPECTED RESULTS
Header/Footer info should print correctly

reference_cases.title: TC-131
reference_cases.description:
STEPS/DESCRIPTION
1. Launch the browser
2. Go to Windows Build Prerequisites
3. Do "File | Print"
4. Once the "Print" dialog comes up, click on the radio button titled "Pages"
5. Enter a value for the number of pages to print (say 1 to 3)

EXPECTED RESULTS:
Only pages 1 to 3 should get printed

technique_rationales.equivalence_partitioning: Cover important input partitions such as different page formats, XML, HTML, CSS, frame configurations, and styles as required by R-109 through R-126.
technique_rationales.boundary_value_analysis: Exercise stated limits such as large page printing and specific page number ranges for print jobs specified in R-118 and R-131.
technique_rationales.state_transition: Cover states and transitions involved in switching between portrait and landscape settings, online and off-line printing, and interacting with Print Preview and Page Setup dialogs.
technique_rationales.use_case: Cover end-to-end user flows for printing documents, using print preview, configuring page setups, and selecting page ranges.
technique_rationales.error_guessing: Explore plausible failures regarding off-line printing scenarios, malformed frames, and improper header/footer information printing.
